newsitem.title: USA: Ahmanson asks Great Western to end delays.
newsitem.headline: Ahmanson asks Great Western to end delays.

text.p: H.F. Ahmanson & Co said Tuesday that Great Western Financial Corp should stop its delaying tactics and start discussions with Ahmanson about a merger.
"Great Western should cease its delays ... and commence discussions with us immediately," Ahmanson said in a statement.
Ahmanson was responding to Great Western's statement earlier today that it was reviewing Ahmanson's hostile $6.2 billion takeover bid and that it opposed Ahmanson's consent solicitation.
Great Western also said it had postponed its annual meeting, scheduled for April 22, because shareholders did not have all the information they needed about the Ahmanson proposal.
Ahmanson called this "a coercive effort to preclude Great Western's shareholders...from excercising their legal rights."
Ahmanson said Great Western's statement about additional information was "double-speak and disingenous." It said Great Western had not sought any additional information about the takeover bid.
"For our part, H.F. Ahmanson & Co is committed to the merger proposal and to pursuing the actions we have initiated in that regard," Ahmanson said.
